product_metadata.title: MIPAHI 2-Pack Hand Braided Heart Fans,Summer Fans Peach Shaped Bamboo Fans for Home Decor or Summer Beach,Party Weddings
features: High-Quality Material:Made of high-quality bamboo woven material,it looks delicate and environmentally friendly,and it is light in weight and easy to carry and use.
Pure Hand-Woven:The fan is hand-woven,which looks very advanced without losing its charm.It also has a faint bamboo fragrance,which makes people very fond of it.
Unique Design:The heart-shaped design looks full of love,and the natural color has a natural atmosphere,which is very creative.
Appropriate Size:The size of this heart-shaped fan is about 38*30cm/14.96*11.81inch.It is light in weight and can be used anytime in summer as a cool artifact.
Wide Range of Applications:Bamboo fans with unique natural design can be used for cool summer or various decorations at home and wedding parties,and can also be given as gifts to loved ones.
